decisions.reason: As a standard Christmas pyramid very close to the firm's traditional craft and product architecture, it can be sustained and incrementally refined within the core range even if later website visibility was low.

This Christmas motif platform depends on the electronic music-box concept that is distant from the firm's knowledge base and already undermined by earlier withdrawals, so the firm is very likely to discontinue it.

The Dresden-themed pyramid builds on established woodworking and seasonal design capabilities, so despite its narrower theme and weaker later visibility it is still more likely to be retained than removed.
